address: Le Bristol, 114 rue du Faubourg-Saint-Honoré, Paris, 75008, France
bio: Situated within Le Bristol, this brasserie is truly one of a kind! The interior will win you over at first glance: interspersed with imposing gilded columns, it has large luminescent dahlia motifs on its orange walls. At its heart, a grand staircase opens up, leading down to the lower level where tables rub shoulders with the open kitchens. Chic, shimmering, both bustling and intimate, this place hits all the right notes. As for the food, this is a discreetly original take on the French classics we know and love. Dishes are carefully presented and flavours are beautifully combined. This is a lesson in how things should be done....
